## Matrice de preuves

Utiliser uniquement : `LOCAL_EXECUTED`, `CI_PROVEN`, `OWNER_E2E`, `NOT_EXECUTED`.

| Contrôle | Statut | Preuve |
|---|---|---|
| diff check | NOT_EXECUTED | — |
| type-check | NOT_EXECUTED | — |
| QA ciblée | NOT_EXECUTED | — |
| regression QA | NOT_EXECUTED | — |
| lint | NOT_EXECUTED | — |
| build | NOT_EXECUTED | — |
| E2E requis | NOT_EXECUTED | — |
